reviews.text: James did a remarkable job with our fur baby who was very timid about having his hair trimmed. I was also very impressed with the cleanliness of the mobile grooming van and equipment. We will be return customers and would highly recommend this company and groomer to others.

Amanda is our groomer and is great with Max. Always on time, knowledgeable and gives a beautiful haircut. Sadly she moved  on after a few yrs.  They gave me Milo who is wonderful with my Welsh Terrier.  Kind, gently and give great grooming to my per. Have me with them for quite a few yrs and never an issue.
I’ve attempted to use this groomer twice and both times the called and canceled on me an hour or two before the scheduled appointment. Will not be going back.

I had an appointment for 12/4/25. They call and rescheduled for 12/15/25 at 4:25. They texted that it could be an hour before or an hour after depending on the traffic. I called the office at 5:00 asking about my appointment. The lady said she could see my appointment and that the manager or groomer would call me. It is now 6:15 and no one has called. I’m very disappointed at their unprofessional behavior. The first two times they groomed my dog they were great. After this I’m taking my business somewhere else.

Used to be a huge fan of them.  Loved our groomer Amanda!  Well they cancelled my last appointment the day before and couldn’t rebook for over a month.  This time they literally confirmed my appointment in the morning and then a few hours later, cancelled and said my groomer no longer worked there and they had no one else who could help me.  What the heck?  This is no way to run a business.  So disappointed.  We will be taking our business elsewhere.

Yes I would just like to say Im very sad as well as My Chico going to MISS JAMES VERY MUCH 😔 Chico really loved him was gentle and did very good job on grooming

Good Luck James Thank You Once Again for being such A GOOD CARE & LOVING GROOMER 🥰

Very unprofessional waited for a appointment for 2 weeks then the day before my appointment I get a text saying that my appointment was canceled And that they can fit my in another week.
This is what I get for using corporate company

I HAVE BEEN A REGULAR REPEAT CUSTOMER
FOR ABOUT 2 years!
Grooming appointment for my Corgi was scheduled 6 weeks ago for. 6/30/2025 for 11 am. I received confirmation texts on Wednesday & Saturday prior to my Monday appointment asking me to confirm with instructions that your groomer maybe 1 hour early of 1 hour later, etc. Monday 6/30/2025 came and the groomer was NO SHOW & NO COMMUNICATION so at 3pm I called the general phone. The operator confirmed my appointment and simply said I’m sorry for but your groomer no longer works here we have 2 male groomers that maybe able to groom your pet and continued to give me dates and times, I STOPPED her and said I will not be making another appointment at this time because what happened today is UNACCEPTABLE AND UNPROFESSIONAL! I waited a little more than 24hrs and no one from the company has reached out to with an apology!

Cancelled my appointment twice. I rearranged my entire day to be home and available, and no one ever called to notify me that no one would be coming. I even confirmed the appointment two days prior. Completely unprofessional and disrespectful of my time, and didn’t make an effort to make it right. I recommend you take your business elsewhere.

I’m so disappointed by my experience with Furry Land today. James showed up early at 2:20 pm and finished at about 3:15. My Ragdoll cat, N’Jadaka, had matting from stress that I hadn’t been able to comb out. I told James that the mats would need to be cut out, but I was okay with N’J being shaved if that was easiest for him and I wanted to avoid any pain to N’J. James returned N’J and told me they cut his nails, cleaned his ears and they were real dirty and didn’t have to shave or cut the mats because they “brushed right out” and that he was still a little wet underneath by his belly because he didn’t like the hair dryer. James also told us that we would need to brush his belly out ourselves because N’J didn’t like it. I trusted what James told us, I don’t know why, and tipped them $30.
When I took N’J out of his crate, he was SOAKED and so scared. I picked him up to dry him myself but he was so upset he scratched me and then ran away. By the cut I received from N’J’s nails, it was obvious they had not been cut. I’m not sure what James did for nearly an hour but my cat looked and smelled like a wet mop and hasn’t come out of hiding since.
I was charged $125 for cat grooming and tipped $30.
I will be calling Furry Land tomorrow to see if they record the groomers as they groom to see exactly what was done for N’Jadaka.

Milton did a phenomenal job, he did all 4 of our dogs ( 2 bull dogs, 1 Great Dane, and 1 Scottie Mix). All of the dogs looked shiny and great! He took his time with each one and was super polite and inquired about each request.

Although, with our old guy our scottie he had been acting kind of off. His whiskers were cut off so he's been a little disoriented. We realized that after a vet visit and coming out of pocket.
Absolutely amazing!!  James did such a great job. We will call hm again the next time we need a grooming.

Added a before and after photo. Super impressed with the quality service Milton provided. He was easy to talk to and made sure my dog was well taken care of. I asked for a 'summer cut' and let Milton take care of the wrest, couldn't be happier. Will be scheduling again in the future.
Highly recommend and trust our fur babies with James from Furryland.  We have James on a regular schedule to care for our two cats and two large dogs.  Five star care!!!
James groomed my two Miniature Australian Shepherds today and did a great job, would definitely recommend.

Amanda at Furry Land Mobile Grooming is absolutely amazing! She took such great care of Esmeralda, making the grooming process stress-free and enjoyable. Amanda’s professionalism, kindness, and attention to detail truly set her apart. She was patient and gentle, ensuring Essie felt comfortable throughout the entire session. The convenience of the mobile service combined with Amanda’s exceptional skills makes Furry Land the best choice for grooming. I couldn’t be happier with the results- Essie looks and feels fantastic! Highly recommend Amanda for anyone looking for top-tier care for their pets!
Milton is very good with dogs. My dog Bailey loves ❤️  him.
Was so wonderful to get my mini poodle bathed and trimmed at the campground where we were staying. Love Furry Land! The groomer was kind, informative and timely. Highly recommend.
Amanda was wonderful with my little girl Gracie I would like to schedule her for a once a month grooming she was very good and I am very pleased with your company
